absolute_rules: No training/fitting/tuning/threshold changes. No live orders. No cloud. No commit/push.
Causal past-only: every feature/calibration/vote input at decision time T uses only candles with close_time <= T.
Missing checkpoint/calibrator/config asset fails CLOSED with a readiness error naming the file; never replay signals, toy logic, or alternate policy.
WARMUP (insufficient history) is a distinct status, never a strategy WAIT.
Do not edit the OpenCode ledger (leader-only) or any Codex file.

anchor_stride.anchor: first research decision bar_index 36864 (= 2022-05-09T00:00:00Z open; 36864 % 72 == 0, i.e. 6h-UTC-grid aligned)
anchor_stride.rule: decision bars are closed 5m bars with open_time on the 6h UTC grid (00/06/12/18) AND >= WARMUP_BARS bars of contiguous history at/before the bar; stride 72 bars (6h)

batch_reference.calibrate: calibrate_all (np.interp selection_score_percent on frozen iso map, pred[...,0]=mapped/fill)
batch_reference.choose: swing.choose per map with research policy gates (min 0.3 net / 0.25 fill), iso4 geometry via swing.prices
batch_reference.combine: ensemble_value.combine stacked (3,n,16,6) with disagreement_penalty 0.0 (verbatim v02 plan)

feature_builder.sequence_encoder: src/agentic_alpha_lab/data/sequence_context.py encode_windows (window-only dimensionless norm, no fitted statistics)
feature_builder.store_base: src/agentic_alpha_lab/data/kronos_trading.py WindowStore.at (searchsorted right on closed-bar ends; incomplete HTF bucket discarded by resample_closed_ohlcv)

frequency_policy.order: chronological (stable argsort on decision_time); skip when decision_time < next_allowed or month cap reached; emits iso4 choose() geometry

batch_reference.htf_proof: for each decision, last used bar close_time per TF (5min/15min/1h/4h/1d) must satisfy close_time <= decision_time; WindowStore.at guarantees ends <= as_of and resample drops the forming bucket; adapter records and asserts this per decision

calibrators.fit_provenance: FROZEN, fit 2025-12-01 vintage on pre-cutoff labels only; no refit in this round

feature_schema.atr: :param: atr5 (5m) + atr4 (4h) rolling-14 true-range means at decision bar
feature_schema.context_feat40: context_features(windows): 5 TF x (ret_1/3/12, dist-high, dist-low, range14, trend30, vol_ratio30) = 40 float32, clipped [-10,10]; past-only
feature_schema.flat133_note: forward features.npz (n,133) is a frozen batch artifact; first 40 cols == feat40 (asserted rtol 1e-6 in r66 build_sequences). Adapter rebuilds feat40 live from candles, never loads features.npz.
feature_schema.sequences: (5 TF, 128 bars, 6 OHLCV) float32 -> encode_windows -> (5,128,6) float32

input_contract.market: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT closed 5m candles, contiguous, stable UTC timestamps; last close_time < now (no forming bar)

policy_identity: v29 fold-10 3-seed residual-GRU ensemble (penalty 0.0) + frozen fold-10 iso2/iso4/isoall maps + per-map choose() with research policy gates + B4 vote (majority: >=2/3 agree with iso4 side incl. iso4; confirmed: d4 != 0 AND dall == d4, iso4 geometry) + frequency cap 4/month + cooldown 5d. Reference branch for r76 parity: confirmed (pre-guard; dd_guard sizing is an execution overlay, not part of this inference adapter).

scaler_normalization.fitted_scaler: NONE. Normalization is per-window and stateless (encode_windows log/scale + context clip). No frozen mean/std file exists or is needed; training contract preserved by using the identical functions.

status_codes.READY_DECISION: sufficient history; row carries final action (WAIT/LONG/SHORT)
status_codes.WARMUP: fewer than 36864 closed bars; never a strategy WAIT

training_cutoff: 2026-03-23T00:00:00Z (development_cutoff in plan.json; research candles 2022-01-01..2026-03-22, 444096 bars; calibrator asof 2025-12-01, latest labels 2025-11-22, all pre-cutoff)

warmup.derivation: context=128 bars on the coarsest TF (1d) -> 128 closed daily bars = 128*288 = 36864 5m bars; confirmed by first research decision bar_index 36864
